s1.syndrome_frame: chronic pruritic eyelid plaque with lymphocytic infiltrates
salient_findings: pruritic, dark red plaque on the right upper eyelid
perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates around cystically dilated follicular infundibula
key_facts: 1-year history of a pruritic, dark red plaque on the right upper eyelid
plaque is 4 × 2-cm, erythematous, violaceous, indurated, and scaly with papules
routine blood tests and biochemistry analysis were within normal limits
histopathologic examination revealed perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates
exocytosis of atypical lymphocytes into the epithelium
admixed plasma cells, eosinophils, and multinucleate giant cells
focal mild follicular mucin deposition on Alcian blue staining
lymphocytic infiltrates positive for CD3, CD4, CD5, and CD7
lymphocytic infiltrates negative for CD8, CD20, CD30, CD79a, and CD56
CD4 to CD8 cells ratio within hair follicles > 7:1
monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement was demonstrated

shortlist.label: Mycosis fungoides
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic pruritic eyelid plaque with lymphocytic infiltrates and monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement

shortlist.label: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD4-positive lymphocytic infiltrates and atypical lymphocytes in the epithelium

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lymphocytic infiltrates with perifollicular distribution and exocytosis of atypical lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical lymphocytes and mixed inflammatory cell infiltrate

shortlist.label: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD4-positive lymphocytic infiltrates and possibility of large cell transformation

raw.rationale: The presence of a long-standing, pruritic, erythematous plaque with histopathologic findings of perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates, exocytosis of atypical lymphocytes, and a CD4 to CD8 ratio > 7:1, along with monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement, are characteristic of mycosis fungoides.

rejected.label: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While this condition also presents with CD4+ lymphocytes, the clinical and histopathologic features described are more typical of mycosis fungoides.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes mycosis fungoides; the specific features described point more directly to mycosis fungoides.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Typically presents with papular lesions that resolve with scarring, which does not match the description of a persistent plaque.

rejected.label: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Characterized by large anaplastic cells, which were not described in the histopathologic findings.
